M0-0.description: Engineering foundation baseline: runnable web workbench, API, isolated worker, shared contracts, container topology, tests, and CI gates.

M1-0.description: Isolated Sidecar/Adapter integration of MoneyPrinterTurbo based on a fixed, auditable version.
M1-0.security_boundary: Access is completely isolated via local same-origin Sidecar/Adapter network requests. No credentials or API tokens are hardcoded. Degradation fallback is provided.

remaining_mock_boundaries.ffmpeg_real_media: At M1-0 acceptance, real FFmpeg transcoding/rendering was still a mock; M2-0 later replaces this boundary.
remaining_mock_boundaries.ai_style_transfer_and_subtitles: Real AI generation and subtitle processing in AIProvider remains a mock.
remaining_mock_boundaries.video-use: video-use is reserved for M2 and not integrated in M1-0.

M1-0.m2_boundary: M2 was authorized separately after M1-0 acceptance; this record does not pre-accept M2.

M2-0.description: Real FFmpeg media processing plus an isolated, pinned browser-use/video-use Sidecar and same-origin project render flow.
M2-0.security_boundary: The Sidecar runs as a non-root internal service. Uploads use generated media IDs, render requests use validated project/media IDs, and no endpoint accepts an arbitrary host path or shell command.
acceptance_pending: GitHub Actions Docker Compose job with pinned-upstream real render

remaining_boundaries.transcription: The real ElevenLabs Scribe path is implemented but is unavailable until ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is configured.
remaining_boundaries.ai_style_transfer: AIProvider cartoon style transfer remains a mock and is outside this video-use/FFmpeg milestone.
remaining_boundaries.opencut: OpenCut Classic editor embedding is M3-0 and is not claimed by M2-0.
remaining_boundaries.openreel: OpenReel compatibility is a later feature-flagged fallback and is not claimed by M2-0.
remaining_boundaries.production_launch: No public host, domain, TLS endpoint, or production provider secrets have been supplied, so public launch is not claimed.
